holderQuote: The Drake he’d stabbed rose up, punched Pisces with a roar, and the other Drakes charged. Pisces yelped, and Selys saw him stagger back. The injured Drake charged him—
effectQuote: And received a face full of razor-sharp stone shards. He screamed and fell, clawing at his eyes. Pisces whirled. Someone charged him with a club. The [Mage]’s form blurred and he lunged—the thrust of his rapier went through the Drake’s chest and out the other side. The [Thug] stumbled, dropped. Pisces backed up, cursing, as he tried to withdraw his fragile blade.

holderQuote: He turned his head and bent backwards. Pisces missed the tip of Grimalkin’s face with his flaming rapier. He pointed with his free hand.
